audit_items.proof_trace: `STEM_BOT_API_BEARER_TOKEN` lacks the `NEXT_PUBLIC_` prefix, so Next.js framework guarantees it is stripped from client bundles and never exposed to the browser. Across all 8 call sites (members.ts, generations.ts, teams.ts, dashboard/page.tsx), the token variable is assigned only to the `Authorization` header and is never interpolated into any log string or return value; error logging records only the external API's response status/body, and error return paths either propagate void/null or static label strings — not the token value.
